description: The FIRST conjunct of the authorisation filter, isolated: the same admin-only stub entry as case11, chosen by an administrator. 88 CDEMO-USRTYP-USER (app/cpy/COCOM01Y.cpy) is false for user type 'A', so app/cbl/COMEN01C.cbl:136 short-circuits the whole filter regardless of the 'A' in the authorisation column, the error flag stays off, and the dispatch at 146-155 transfers to the entry's target program with the communication area. Holding the table and the option identical to case11 and varying only CDEMO-USER-TYPE is what makes this a controlled comparison: the two cases differ by one byte of input and produce a painted refusal versus a transfer. A translation testing 'not admin' instead of 'is user' would agree here and disagree on a blank user type.
